50085387.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to GST-thrombin-tagged human MDM2 (1 to 188) expressed in Escherichia coli after 1 to 2 mins by surface plasmon resonance spectroscopic analysis

Y.; Schneider, S.; Shaffer, P.; Xiao, S.-H.; Yakowec, P.; Yan, X.; Ye, Q.; Zhao, X.; Zhou, J.; Medina, J. C.; Olson, S. H. Structure-based design of novel inhibitors of the MDM2-p53 interaction. J. original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) experiments were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare) using a CM5 sensor chip. GST-thrombin-tagged human MDM2 (1 to 188) was expressed in Escherichia coli and purified as described previously.21 The protein was immobilized on the sensor chip at a level of approximately 1000 response units (RU). The running buffer was 10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 0.005% P20. Compounds were dissolved in DMSO and diluted in running buffer to the desired concentrations. The assay was performed at 25 °C with a flow rate of 30 μL/min. The association phase lasted for 1 min, followed by a 2-min dissociation phase. Regeneration was achieved with 10 mM glycine, pH 2.0, for 30 s. Data were analyzed using Biacore T200 evaluation software. The binding affinity (KD) was determined by fitting the sensorgrams to a 1:1 Langmuir binding model.
